name: Ghost Trail Ultimate
description: 🔥 Ultimate ghost trail effect with 10 stunning visual modes: Rainbow, Neon, Fire, Ice, Galaxy, Chromatic aberration, Glitch, Pulse, and more! Fully customizable with advanced animation settings.

enabled.name: ✨ Enable Ghost Trail
enabled.description: Master toggle for the ghost trail effect.

spawn-rate.name: ⚡ Spawn Rate
spawn-rate.description: Ghost sprites per second. Higher = smoother trail, more GPU usage.

fade-duration.name: ⏱️ Fade Duration
fade-duration.description: How long ghosts take to fade out (seconds).

scale-end.name: 📐 End Scale
scale-end.description: Final scale multiplier when ghost fades (1.0 = same size, 0.5 = half).

rotation-speed.name: 🔄 Rotation Speed
rotation-speed.description: How much ghosts rotate while fading (degrees per second).

rainbow-speed.name: 🌈 Rainbow Speed
rainbow-speed.description: Speed of rainbow color cycling (for Rainbow/Neon modes).

glitch-intensity.name: 📺 Glitch Intensity
glitch-intensity.description: Intensity of position glitch effect (for Glitch mode).

trail-length.name: 📏 Trail Length
trail-length.description: Visual length of the trail (affects fade timing).

only-moving.name: 🏃 Only When Moving
only-moving.description: Only spawn ghosts when the player is actually moving.

additive-blend.name: 💡 Additive Blending
additive-blend.description: Use additive blend mode for glowing effect.

dual-color.name: 🎭 Use Player Color
dual-color.description: Use player's icon color (Classic mode only).

mirror-mode.name: 🪞 Mirror Mode
mirror-mode.description: Create mirrored ghost trail for trippy symmetry effect.
